title: Optimize Medal
name: optimize-medal
description: Keeps Medal's clipping from tanking your FPS: lowers its CPU priority, moves it to the integrated GPU and clears its caches to free RAM.
deepDescription:
Medal continuously records a replay buffer, which uses RAM and GPU time that your game needs. This tweak:

- Sets every **Medal.exe** process to **BelowNormal** priority so the game always wins the CPU.
- Routes Medal to the **integrated GPU** (GpuPreference=1), keeping the dedicated GPU free for the game.
- Clears Medal's **Cache**, **Code Cache**, **GPUCache** and log folders to free RAM and disk space.

Fully reversible — priorities and the GPU preference are restored on revert.
